mapper.select: SELECT id, theme_name AS themeName, description, price, thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, theme_code AS themeCode, status, is_default AS isDefault, updated_at AS updatedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM theme ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO theme ( theme_name, description, price, thumbnail_url, theme_code ) VALUES ( #{themeName}, #{description}, #{price}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{themeCode} )
mapper.update: UPDATE theme SET theme_name = #{request.themeName}, description = #{request.description}, price = #{request.price}, thumbnail_url = #{request.thumbnailUrl}, theme_code = #{request.themeCode} WHERE id = #{themeId}
